decision: held: the only source, 39106912 (Complement Ther Med 2024), has no open full text; its included trials, chamomile preparations, doses and the composition of the 5-study PSQI pool cannot be verified, so no context can be completed. OA retry 2026-10-28: 39106912 is gold CC-BY (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ctim.2024.103071) but ScienceDirect refused both curl and the browser pane.
summary: 39106912 abstract: 10 clinical trials (772 adults); PSQI improved in a 5-study pool (WMD -1.88, -3.46 to -0.31, I2 88.4%); sleep duration, efficiency and daytime functioning did not improve; only one study checked blinding or product purity. The signal is limited and heterogeneous.

source_receipts.title_fetched: Effects of chamomile (Matricaria chamomilla L.) on sleep: A systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical trials.
